14:   sent: boolean;
15:   channelOk: boolean;
16:   dmOk: boolean;
17:   listingCount: number;
18: }

20: /**
21:  * Format a digest message body from the collected listings, grouped by type.
22:  * Each section is capped and overflows are noted.
23:  */
24: export function formatDigest(listingsToShow: ListingRow[]): string {
25:   const groups = {
26:     have: listingsToShow.filter((l) => l.intent === 'have'),
27:     want: listingsToShow.filter((l) => l.intent === 'want'),
28:   };
29: 
30:   const sections: string[] = [];
31:   const pushSection = (title: string, rows: ListingRow[]): void => {
32:     if (rows.length === 0) {
33:       return;
34:     }
35:     const shown = rows.slice(0, DIGEST_SECTION_CAP);
36:     const lines = shown.map(digestLine).join('\n');
37:     const overflow =
38:       rows.length > DIGEST_SECTION_CAP ? `\n+${rows.length - DIGEST_SECTION_CAP} more` : '';
39:     sections.push(`${title} (${rows.length})\n${lines}${overflow}`);
40:   };
41: 
42:   pushSection('NEW HAVES', groups.have);
43:   pushSection('NEW WANTS', groups.want);
44: 
45:   return sections.join('\n\n');
46: }
47: 
48: /**
49:  * Run a digest for one server. Follows the watermark rules in the spec: only
50:  * listings created after `last_digest_at` are selected, delivery is by
51:  * `digest_mode`, and the watermark only advances when at least one destination
52:  * succeeds.
53:  */
54: export async function runDigest(
55:   client: Client,
56:   server: ServerRow,
57:   trigger: DigestTrigger,
58: ): Promise<DigestResult> {
59:   const collected = prepareDigestListings(server);
60: 
61:   const empty: DigestResult = { sent: false, channelOk: false, dmOk: false, listingCount: 0 };
62:   if (collected.length === 0) {
63:     return empty;
64:   }
65: 
66:   const heading = `Daily Listing Digest — ${new Date(now()).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
67:     year: 'numeric',
68:     month: 'long',
69:     day: 'numeric',
70:   })}`;
71:   const message = `${heading}\n\n${formatDigest(collected)}`;
72: 
73:   let channelOk = false;
74:   let dmOk = false;
75:   if (server.digestMode === 'channel' || server.digestMode === 'both') {
76:     channelOk = await deliverToChannel(client, server, message);
77:   }
78:   if (server.digestMode === 'dm' || server.digestMode === 'both') {
79:     dmOk = await deliverToDm(client, server, message);
80:   }
81: 
82:   if (!channelOk && !dmOk) {
83:     // No destination succeeded; record the failure and leave the watermark
84:     // unchanged so the same listings are retried next time.
85:     logDigest(server.id, trigger, collected, { channel: false, dm: false });
86:     sendCriticalAlert(`Digest delivery failed for server ${server.id}`);
87:     return { sent: false, channelOk, dmOk, listingCount: collected.length };
88:   }
89: 
90:   setServerWatermark(server.id, now());
91:   logDigest(server.id, trigger, collected, { channel: channelOk, dm: dmOk });
92:   return { sent: true, channelOk, dmOk, listingCount: collected.length };
93: }

95: async function deliverToChannel(
96:   client: Client,
97:   server: ServerRow,
98:   message: string,
99: ): Promise<boolean> {
100:   if (!server.adminChannelId) {
101:     return false;
102:   }
103:   try {
104:     const channel = (await client.channels.fetch(server.adminChannelId)) as TextChannel | null;
105:     if (!channel || !channel.isTextBased() || !channel.isSendable()) {
106:       return false;
107:     }
108:     await retryWithBackoff(
109:       () => channel.send({ content: message, allowedMentions: { parse: [] } }),
110:       {
111:         attempts: 3,
112:         baseDelayMs: 1000,
113:         maxDelayMs: 8000,
114:       },
115:     );
116:     return true;
117:   } catch {
118:     return false;
119:   }
120: }
121: 
122: async function deliverToDm(client: Client, server: ServerRow, message: string): Promise<boolean> {
123:   if (!server.digestDmUserId) {
124:     return false;
125:   }
126:   try {
127:     const user = (await client.users.fetch(server.digestDmUserId)) as User | null;
128:     if (!user) {
129:       return false;
130:     }
131:     await retryWithBackoff(() => user.send({ content: message, allowedMentions: { parse: [] } }), {
132:       attempts: 3,
133:       baseDelayMs: 1000,
134:       maxDelayMs: 8000,
135:     });
136:     return true;
137:   } catch {
138:     return false;
139:   }
140: }
141:

153:       trigger,
154:       listingCount: included.length,
155:       listingIdsIncluded: JSON.stringify(included.map((l) => l.id)),
156:       deliveryResults: JSON.stringify(results),
157:     })
158:     .run();
159: }

2: import { getDb } from '../db/index.js';
3: import { listings, servers, type ListingRow, type ServerRow } from '../db/schema.js';
4: import {
5:   DEFAULT_DIGEST_CRON,

10: const now = () => Date.now();
11: 
12: /**
13:  * Fetch all servers that have an active digest delivery mode. Used at startup
14:  * to schedule cron jobs.
15:  */
16: export function listScheduledServers(): ServerRow[] {
17:   const db = getDb();
18:   return db.select().from(servers).where(ne(servers.digestMode, 'disabled')).all();
19: }
20: 
21: /**
22:  * Select the active listings that belong in a digest for this server using the
23:  * `last_digest_at` watermark. On the very first digest the watermark is the
24:  * value set when digest config completed, so only listings created afterward
25:  * are included.
26:  */
27: export function prepareDigestListings(server: ServerRow): ListingRow[] {
28:   const db = getDb();
29:   const from = server.lastDigestAt ?? 0;
30:   return db
31:     .select()
32:     .from(listings)
33:     .where(
34:       and(
35:         eq(listings.serverId, server.id),
36:         eq(listings.status, 'active'),
37:         gte(listings.createdAt, from),
38:         lte(listings.createdAt, now()),
39:       ),
40:     )
41:     .orderBy(asc(listings.createdAt))
42:     .all();
43: }
44: 
45: /** Advance the server's digest watermark after a successful delivery. */
46: export function setServerWatermark(serverId: string, timestamp: number): void {
47:   const db = getDb();
48:   db.update(servers)
49:     .set({ lastDigestAt: timestamp, updatedAt: now() })
50:     .where(eq(servers.id, serverId))
51:     .run();
52: }
53: 
54: /**
55:  * Initialize the watermark to the current time when digest mode moves from
56:  * disabled to an active mode, so a digest does not flood with old listings.
57:  */
58: export function initializeWatermarkIfNeeded(server: ServerRow): void {
59:   if (server.digestMode === 'disabled' || server.lastDigestAt !== null) {
60:     return;
61:   }
62:   setServerWatermark(server.id, now());
63: }

65: /** Persist or create the server configuration row. */
66: export function upsertServerConfig(partial: {
67:   serverId: string;
68:   digestMode?: string;
69:   digestCron?: string;
70:   digestTimezone?: string;
71:   adminChannelId?: string | null;
72:   digestDmUserId?: string | null;
73:   enabledGames?: string[];
74: }): ServerRow {
75:   const db = getDb();
76:   const timestamp = now();
77:   const existing = db.select().from(servers).where(eq(servers.id, partial.serverId)).get();
78:   if (!existing) {
79:     const row: ServerRow = {
80:       id: partial.serverId,
81:       adminChannelId: partial.adminChannelId ?? null,
82:       digestDmUserId: partial.digestDmUserId ?? null,
83:       digestMode: partial.digestMode ?? DEFAULT_DIGEST_MODE,
84:       digestCron: partial.digestCron ?? DEFAULT_DIGEST_CRON,
85:       digestTimezone: partial.digestTimezone ?? DEFAULT_DIGEST_TIMEZONE,
86:       lastDigestAt: null,

92:     db.insert(servers).values(row).run();
93:     return row;
94:   }
95:   const update: Partial<ServerRow> = { updatedAt: timestamp };
96:   if (partial.adminChannelId !== undefined) update.adminChannelId = partial.adminChannelId;
97:   if (partial.digestDmUserId !== undefined) update.digestDmUserId = partial.digestDmUserId;
98:   if (partial.digestMode !== undefined) update.digestMode = partial.digestMode;
